title: B1: Ward Census - Who was on the ward on January 1st?
description: Beginner lesson: List of every patient admitted on 2026-01-01 with demographics and admission/discharge window

queries.label: Ward Census Query
queries.sql:
SELECT
    p.full_name,
    p.mrn,
    p.age,
    p.sex,
    p.admitted_at,
    e.ended_at,
    e.status
FROM mysql.clinical.patients p
JOIN mysql.clinical.encounters e
    ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id
ORDER BY p.admitted_at
